title: Eine neue Wohnung — A New Apartment
summary: A young couple searches for a new apartment in the city.

paragraphs.text: Meine Freundin und ich suchen eine neue Wohnung.
paragraphs.translation: My girlfriend and I are looking for a new apartment.
paragraphs.translation_en: My girlfriend and I are looking for a new apartment.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pacar saya dan saya sedang mencari apartemen baru.

paragraphs.text: Wir wollen im Zentrum wohnen, aber dort sind die Wohnungen sehr teuer.
paragraphs.translation: We want to live downtown, but the apartments there are very expensive.
paragraphs.translation_en: We want to live downtown, but the apartments there are very expensive.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami ingin tinggal di pusat kota, tapi apartemen di sana sangat mahal.

paragraphs.text: Am Dienstag besuchen wir eine Wohnung mit zwei Zimmern.
paragraphs.translation: On Tuesday we visit an apartment with two rooms.
paragraphs.translation_en: On Tuesday we visit an apartment with two rooms.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hari Selasa kami mengunjungi apartemen dua kamar.

paragraphs.text: Die Küche ist groß und das Wohnzimmer hat viel Licht.
paragraphs.translation: The kitchen is big and the living room has lots of light.
paragraphs.translation_en: The kitchen is big and the living room has lots of light.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dapurnya besar dan ruang tamunya banyak cahaya.

paragraphs.text: Aber die Miete ist zu hoch für uns. Wir suchen weiter.
paragraphs.translation: But the rent is too high for us. We keep looking.
paragraphs.translation_en: But the rent is too high for us. We keep looking.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tapi sewanya terlalu mahal bagi kami. Kami terus mencari.

summary_en: A young couple searches for a new apartment in the city.
summary_id: Sepasang muda mencari apartemen baru di kota.

title: Beim Arzt — At the Doctor
summary: Markus has a headache and visits the doctor.

paragraphs.text: Markus hat seit drei Tagen Kopfschmerzen.
paragraphs.translation: Markus has had a headache for three days.
paragraphs.translation_en: Markus has had a headache for three days.
paragraphs.translation_id: Markus sakit kepala sejak tiga hari lalu.

paragraphs.text: Am Freitagmorgen geht er zum Arzt.
paragraphs.translation: On Friday morning he goes to the doctor.
paragraphs.translation_en: On Friday morning he goes to the doctor.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jumat pagi dia pergi ke dokter.

paragraphs.text: Der Arzt fragt: "Was ist los?"
paragraphs.translation: The doctor asks: "What's the matter?"
paragraphs.translation_en: The doctor asks: "What's the matter?"
paragraphs.translation_id: Dokter bertanya: "Ada apa?"

paragraphs.text: Markus antwortet: "Ich schlafe schlecht und arbeite zu viel."
paragraphs.translation: Markus answers: "I sleep badly and work too much."
paragraphs.translation_en: Markus answers: "I sleep badly and work too much."
paragraphs.translation_id: Markus menjawab: "Saya tidur buruk dan bekerja terlalu banyak."

paragraphs.text: Der Arzt empfiehlt eine Woche Ruhe und verschreibt Tabletten.
paragraphs.translation: The doctor recommends a week of rest and prescribes tablets.
paragraphs.translation_en: The doctor recommends a week of rest and prescribes tablets.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dokter menyarankan istirahat seminggu dan meresepkan obat tablet.

paragraphs.text: Markus nimmt die Tabletten und fühlt sich am Montag besser.
paragraphs.translation: Markus takes the tablets and feels better on Monday.
paragraphs.translation_en: Markus takes the tablets and feels better on Monday.
paragraphs.translation_id: Markus minum obat dan merasa lebih baik pada hari Senin.

summary_en: Markus has a headache and visits the doctor.
summary_id: Markus sakit kepala dan pergi ke dokter.

title: Ein Tagesausflug nach München — A Day Trip to Munich
summary: A day trip to Munich by train.

paragraphs.text: Letzten Samstag machen wir einen Tagesausflug nach München.
paragraphs.translation: Last Saturday we take a day trip to Munich.
paragraphs.translation_en: Last Saturday we take a day trip to Munich.
paragraphs.translation_id: Sabtu lalu kami bertamasya sehari ke München.

paragraphs.text: Wir kaufen zwei Tickets am Bahnhof und steigen in den Zug.
paragraphs.translation: We buy two tickets at the station and get on the train.
paragraphs.translation_en: We buy two tickets at the station and get on the train.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami membeli dua tiket di stasiun dan naik kereta.

paragraphs.text: Die Fahrt dauert ungefähr eine Stunde.
paragraphs.translation: The trip takes about one hour.
paragraphs.translation_en: The trip takes about one hour.
paragraphs.translation_id: Perjalanannya sekitar satu jam.

paragraphs.text: In München besuchen wir zuerst das Zentrum und die Kirche.
paragraphs.translation: In Munich we first visit the center and the church.
paragraphs.translation_en: In Munich we first visit the center and the church.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di München kami mengunjungi pusat kota dan gereja.

paragraphs.text: Dann essen wir in einem Restaurant und trinken ein Bier.
paragraphs.translation: Then we eat at a restaurant and drink a beer.
paragraphs.translation_en: Then we eat at a restaurant and drink a beer.
paragraphs.translation_id: Lalu kami makan di restoran dan minum bir.

paragraphs.text: Am Abend fahren wir wieder nach Hause. Wir sind müde, aber glücklich.
paragraphs.translation: In the evening we travel home again. We are tired but happy.
paragraphs.translation_en: In the evening we travel home again. We are tired but happy.
paragraphs.translation_id: Malamnya kami pulang. Kami lelah tapi bahagia.

summary_en: A day trip to Munich by train.
summary_id: Tamasya sehari ke München naik kereta.

title: Der Geburtstag — The Birthday
summary: Anna prepares a surprise birthday party for her friend.

paragraphs.text: Am Freitag hat meine beste Freundin Anna Geburtstag.
paragraphs.translation: My best friend Anna has her birthday on Friday.
paragraphs.translation_en: My best friend Anna has her birthday on Friday.
paragraphs.translation_id: Teman baik saya Anna berulang tahun hari Jumat.

paragraphs.text: Ich möchte eine Überraschungsparty organisieren.
paragraphs.translation: I want to organize a surprise party.
paragraphs.translation_en: I want to organize a surprise party.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya ingin mengadakan pesta kejutan.

paragraphs.text: Ich lade zehn Freunde ein und kaufe einen Kuchen.
paragraphs.translation: I invite ten friends and buy a cake.
paragraphs.translation_en: I invite ten friends and buy a cake.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya mengundang sepuluh teman dan membeli kue.

paragraphs.text: Wir dekorieren das Wohnzimmer mit Luftballons.
paragraphs.translation: We decorate the living room with balloons.
paragraphs.translation_en: We decorate the living room with balloons.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami mendekorasi ruang tamu dengan balon.

paragraphs.text: Um acht Uhr kommt Anna. Alle rufen: "Überraschung!"
paragraphs.translation: At eight o'clock Anna arrives. Everyone shouts: "Surprise!"
paragraphs.translation_en: At eight o'clock Anna arrives. Everyone shouts: "Surprise!"
paragraphs.translation_id: Jam delapan Anna datang. Semua berteriak: "Kejutan!"

paragraphs.text: Anna freut sich sehr und sagt: "Das ist das beste Geschenk!"
paragraphs.translation: Anna is very happy and says: "This is the best gift!"
paragraphs.translation_en: Anna is very happy and says: "This is the best gift!"
paragraphs.translation_id: Anna sangat senang dan berkata: "Ini hadiah terbaik!"

summary_en: Anna prepares a surprise birthday party for her friend.
summary_id: Anna menyiapkan pesta kejutan untuk temannya.

title: Mein Wochenende — My Weekend
summary: A relaxed weekend at home and in the park.

paragraphs.text: Am Samstag schlafe ich lange und frühstücke gemütlich.
paragraphs.translation: On Saturday I sleep late and have a relaxed breakfast.
paragraphs.translation_en: On Saturday I sleep late and have a relaxed breakfast.
paragraphs.translation_id: Hari Sabtu saya tidur lama dan sarapan santai.

paragraphs.text: Danach gehe ich mit meinem Hund in den Park.
paragraphs.translation: Afterwards I go to the park with my dog.
paragraphs.translation_en: Afterwards I go to the park with my dog.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah itu saya pergi ke taman bersama anjing saya.

paragraphs.text: Im Park treffe ich einen alten Freund.
paragraphs.translation: In the park I meet an old friend.
paragraphs.translation_en: In the park I meet an old friend.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di taman saya bertemu teman lama.

paragraphs.text: Wir setzen uns auf eine Bank und sprechen über unsere Arbeit.
paragraphs.translation: We sit on a bench and talk about our work.
paragraphs.translation_en: We sit on a bench and talk about our work.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami duduk di bangku dan berbicara tentang pekerjaan kami.

paragraphs.text: Am Abend koche ich Spaghetti und schaue einen Film.
paragraphs.translation: In the evening I cook spaghetti and watch a movie.
paragraphs.translation_en: In the evening I cook spaghetti and watch a movie.
paragraphs.translation_id: Malamnya saya memasak spageti dan menonton film.

paragraphs.text: Am Sonntag mache ich Hausarbeit und lese ein Buch. Ein schönes Wochenende!
paragraphs.translation: On Sunday I do housework and read a book. A nice weekend!
paragraphs.translation_en: On Sunday I do housework and read a book. A nice weekend!
paragraphs.translation_id: Hari Minggu saya mengerjakan pekerjaan rumah dan membaca buku. Akhir pekan yang menyenangkan!

summary_en: A relaxed weekend at home and in the park.
summary_id: Akhir pekan santai di rumah dan di taman.

paragraphs.text: Der Sommer ist meine Lieblingsjahreszeit.
paragraphs.translation: Summer is my favorite season.
paragraphs.translation_en: Summer is my favorite season.
paragraphs.translation_id: Musim panas adalah musim favorit saya.

paragraphs.text: Im Sommer scheint die Sonne und es ist warm.
paragraphs.translation: In summer the sun shines and it is warm.
paragraphs.translation_en: In summer the sun shines and it is warm.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di musim panas matahari bersinar dan udaranya hangat.

paragraphs.text: Nach der Arbeit fahre ich oft zum See.
paragraphs.translation: After work I often drive to the lake.
paragraphs.translation_en: After work I often drive to the lake.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah bekerja saya sering pergi ke danau.

paragraphs.text: Dort schwimme ich und lese in der Sonne.
paragraphs.translation: There I swim and read in the sun.
paragraphs.translation_en: There I swim and read in the sun.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di sana saya berenang dan membaca di bawah sinar matahari.

paragraphs.text: Am Abend essen wir draußen im Garten.
paragraphs.translation: In the evening we eat outside in the garden.
paragraphs.translation_en: In the evening we eat outside in the garden.
paragraphs.translation_id: Malamnya kami makan di luar di taman.

paragraphs.text: Im Juli machen wir Urlaub in Österreich.
paragraphs.translation: In July we take a vacation in Austria.
paragraphs.translation_en: In July we take a vacation in Austria.
paragraphs.translation_id: Di bulan Juli kami berlibur ke Austria.
